title: Dashboard
subtitle: Your widgets, pinned pages and resources

empty.title: Nothing pinned yet
empty.description: Add widgets and pages with "Add to dashboard", or open a page or a resource and select the star in its header. Once something is on it, the dashboard also becomes your start page.

loadError.title: Could not load your dashboard
loadError.description: Your dashboard could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

pin.saveError: Your dashboard could not be saved. Please try again.

card.unavailableDescription: You can no longer open this page. Its permission may have been removed or its plugin is not available.
card.resourceLoadError: This resource could not be loaded.
card.unavailableWidgetDescription: You can no longer use this widget. Its permission or license may have been removed or its plugin is not available.

drag.instructions: To pick up a card, press space or enter. Use the arrow keys to move it. Press space or enter again to drop it in its new place, or press escape to cancel.
drag.outside: {{title}} is no longer over another card.
drag.end: {{title}} was dropped in the place of {{target}}.

reorderError: The new order could not be saved. Your dashboard shows the saved order again.

edit.hint: Drag a card by its handle to move it, or remove it with the button in its corner. Changes are saved right away.

picker.title: Add to dashboard
picker.allAdded: Everything is already on your dashboard.
